baseline.method: Independent HDR Toolbox original run on seven bound Canon JPEG exposures, midpoint-gauged response; standard-method reference, no physical truth

metric_definitions.radiance_log_rmse: sqrt(mean(log(estimate/reference)^2)) over all positive RGB irradiance entries, no alignment
metric_definitions.response_log_rmse: sqrt(mean(log(estimate/reference)^2)) over all256x3 positive response entries
metric_definitions.forward_weighted_adu_rmse: sqrt(sum(w*(predicted_code-observed_code)^2)/sum(w)), w=min(z,255-z) on observed8<=z<=247, else0; inverse monotone response lookup with saturation clipping; all exposures/channels

threshold_provenance: Frozen before local extraction from independent bit-identical upstream repeat; nonzero5e-5 log tolerance allows float32 exposure accumulation across numerical backends, versus frozen stage tolerance3e-6. Observation boundary is1.01times measured upstream residual. Agreement is reproducibility, not independent physical accuracy.
response_log_curvature_definition: Sum of squared interior second differences of log inverse response over256codes and3channels; no code-step normalization. Independent feasible standard curvature plus relative1e-8 numerical allowance.
